# Adam Matthew Steinberger

> Staff Software Architect & AI Automation Engineer based in Greenville, SC. 13+ years shipping RAG systems, event-driven Azure microservices, and automation pipelines. Available September 2026 — Greenville, SC (remote) or US remote.

Adam Matthew Steinberger is a software architect and AI automation engineer specializing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, event-driven microservices on Azure, process engineering, and automation pipelines. He is currently available for full-time Staff Software Architect / AI Automation Engineer roles starting September 2026.

## Key pages

- [Ask my résumé](https://chat.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/): A small RAG chat that answers questions about Adam's experience, stack, and availability using only the content of this site (six questions per session).
- [Hire Me](https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/hire-me): Availability, target roles, résumé, and how to reach him.
- [Story](https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/story): Background, career timeline, and how he approaches architecture and documentation work.
- [Expertise](https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/expertise): The ten technical pillars — AI/ML, RAG, agents & automation, process engineering, Scrum/Agile, software architecture, onion layering, microservices, Azure cloud, and data/integration pipelines.
- [Work](https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/work): Case studies — enterprise RAG systems, Azure microservices, and automation pipelines built for real clients.
- [Open Source](https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/open-source): MIT-licensed packages on PyPI — the `*loop` family of autonomous AI-agent session runners (claudeloop, codexloop, cursorloop, agyloop, qwenloop), the `vibey` conductor and its `vibey-gh` release automation, the `vibey-skills` Claude Code plugin marketplace (formerly vibe-engineering-skills), and the `vibey-bootstrap` Azure Functions library (formerly azure-bootstrap).
- [Writing](https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/writing): Blog posts on AI and automation, plus a free 33-article series on AI chatbots for business.
- [Books](https://hire.adam.matthewsteinberger.com/books): Two books currently in development — Novice to Navigator (AI chatbots for business) and Engineering Influence.
